title: Opt1nmization
body:
Yeah, I know. _Another_ Optimization modpack.
But anyway I designed this thing to only add optimization mods nothing else (expect iris and extra options ig).

# Performance
(Tested with a Core Ultra 245KF, Rx 9060 xt and 8 allocated gigs of ram on fancy preset)
![Modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41b2cfd9c5fd28fbba894220d3197b2b0837ccc9_0.webp)
![Vanilla](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/baa94276739e46751e2bb186653a88e0dd56f761.png)

Note : 
-The fps gain varies **a lot** based on the hardware, weaker hardware will receives a bigger performance gain than stronger one.

-On stronger hardware the fps will varies a lot based on the percpective, up to 50% (Playing normaly/watching the sky)

I hope this make it possible to play mc on y'all's weak laptops.
Big thanks to anyone downloading this and the people who made those mods
